title: Titan Pro 15K Blueberry Sour Razz Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Blueberry Sour Razz combines sweet Blueberry with the tang of Raspberry for a fruit blend that’s bright, tart and full of flavour. Each Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml pod and a 10ml refill container for the Titan Pro 15K device. The mesh coil ensures precise vapour output, while the refill system maintains coil saturation for steady performance. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
